Generated Narrative: StructureMap httpsmart.who.intph4hStructureMapMedicationOverviewLMToMedicationOverviewBundle

map "MedicationOverviewLMToMedicationOverviewBundle" = "http://smart.who.int/ph4h/StructureMap/MedicationOverviewLMToMedicationOverviewBundle"

// All LMs and profiles come from IHE Pharm MEOW (r4 branch). Local copies were
// deleted on this branch.

uses "http://profiles.ihe.net/PHARM/MEOW/StructureDefinition/MedicationOverviewLM" alias MedicationOverviewLM as source
uses "http://profiles.ihe.net/PHARM/MEOW/StructureDefinition/PatientLM" alias PatientLM as source
uses "http://profiles.ihe.net/PHARM/MEOW/StructureDefinition/MedicationTreatmentLineLM" alias MedicationTreatmentLineLM as source
uses "http://profiles.ihe.net/PHARM/MEOW/StructureDefinition/PractitionerLM" alias PractitionerLM as source
uses "http://profiles.ihe.net/PHARM/MEOW/StructureDefinition/MedicationOverview" alias MedicationOverviewBundle as target
uses "http://profiles.ihe.net/PHARM/MEOW/StructureDefinition/MedicationOverviewComposition" alias MedicationOverviewComposition as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/MedicationStatement" alias MedicationStatement as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient" alias Patient as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Practitioner" alias Practitioner as target

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Top-level group: assemble MedicationOverview Bundle (document)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MedicationOverviewLMToMedicationOverviewBundle(source src : MedicationOverviewLM, target tgt : MedicationOverviewBundle) {
  src -> tgt.type = 'document' "bundleType";
  src -> tgt.timestamp = (now()) "bundleTimestamp";
  src ->  uuid() as bid,  uuid() as cid,  uuid() as pid then {
    src ->  tgt.identifier as id,  id.system = 'urn:ietf:rfc:4122',  id.value = bid "bundleIdentifier";
    // Pattern matches ICVPLMToIPS: create the resource as a STANDALONE
    // variable (not via `entry.resource = create(...) as alias`). When you
    // bind via `entry.resource = create('X') as alias`, matchbox infers
    // alias's type from entry.resource (Bundle.entry.resource is the base
    // `Resource`), not from `create('X')`. The helper group then receives a
    // bare Resource and fails to set typed properties (e.g. reasonCode).
    // Assign to entry.resource INSIDE the then block, after the helper has
    // populated the standalone resource.
    src ->  tgt.entry as ce,  ce.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', cid),  create('Composition') as comp then {
      src then MedicationOverviewLMToComposition(src, comp, pid) "compositionContent";
      src -> ce.resource = comp "compositionAssign";
    } "compositionEntry";
    src.patient as pref ->  tgt.entry as pe,  pe.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', pid),  create('Patient') as pat then {
      pref then PatientLMToPatient(pref, pat) "patientContent";
      pref -> pe.resource = pat "patientAssign";
    } "patientEntry";
    // Fully-separated nested form: each create / set / then in its own rule.
    // This is the most explicit form for matchbox to bind variable types.
    src.medicationTreatmentLine as lref -> uuid() as tid then {
      lref -> tgt.entry as te then {
        lref -> te.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', tid) "teFullUrl";
        lref -> create('MedicationStatement') as ms then {
          lref -> ms then MedicationTreatmentLineLMToMedicationStatement(lref, ms, pid) "lineContent";
          lref -> te.resource = ms "lineAssign";
        } "teResource";
      } "lineEntry";
    } "treatmentLines";
  } "setEntries";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MedicationOverviewLM -> MedicationOverviewComposition
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MedicationOverviewLMToComposition(source src : MedicationOverviewLM, target tgt : MedicationOverviewComposition, source pid) {
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "compStatus";
  src ->  create('Coding') as cc,  cc.system = 'http://loinc.org',  cc.code = '56445-0',  cc.display = 'Medication summary Document',  create('CodeableConcept') as ct,  ct.coding = cc,  tgt.type = ct "compType";
  src ->  create('Reference') as subj,  subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid),  tgt.subject = subj "compSubject";
  src -> tgt.date = (now()) "compDate";
  src -> tgt.title = 'Medication Overview' "compTitle";
  src -> tgt.section as sect then {
    src -> sect.title = 'Medication Treatment Lines' "sectTitle";
    src ->  create('Coding') as scc,  scc.system = 'http://loinc.org',  scc.code = '10160-0',  scc.display = 'History of Medication use Narrative',  create('CodeableConcept') as sc,  sc.coding = scc,  sect.code = sc "sectCode";
    src.medicationTreatmentLine as lref ->  create('Reference') as ref,  ref.display = 'Medication Treatment Line',  sect.entry = ref "sectEntry";
  } "sectionTreatmentLines";
  src.verification as v -> tgt.attester as att then {
    v -> att.mode = 'professional' "attMode";
    v.verificationTime as vt -> att.time = vt "attTime";
    v.practicioner as pr ->  create('Reference') as party,  party.display = (pr.name.text),  att.party = party "attParty";
  } "attester";
  src.comment as cm -> create('Annotation') as nt then {
    cm.commentText as ctxt -> nt.text = ctxt "noteText";
    cm.date as d -> nt.time = d "noteTime";
    cm.author as a ->  create('Reference') as ar,  ar.display = (a.name.text),  nt.authorReference = ar "noteAuthor";
    cm -> tgt.note = nt "noteAssign";
  } "noteFromComment";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PatientLM -> FHIR Patient
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group PatientLMToPatient(source src : PatientLM, target tgt : Patient) {
  src.identifier as id -> tgt.identifier = id "patIdentifier";
  src.name as n -> tgt.name = n "patName";
  src.gender as g -> tgt.gender = (g.coding.code) "patGender";
  src.dateOfBirth as d -> tgt.birthDate = d "patBirthDate";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MedicationTreatmentLineLM -> base FHIR R4 MedicationStatement
// (NOT typed as the IHE MedicationTreatmentLine profile — see uses block.)
// Receives the Patient entry's UUID (pid) so MS.subject can reference it.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MedicationTreatmentLineLMToMedicationStatement(source src : MedicationTreatmentLineLM, target tgt : MedicationStatement, source pid) {
  src.identifier as id -> tgt.identifier = id;
  src ->  create('Reference') as subj,  subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid),  tgt.subject = subj "subject";
  src.status as st -> tgt.status = st;
  // R4 medication[x] choice — assign directly, no CodeableReference wrapper
  src.medicationReference as mr -> tgt.medicationReference = mr "medicationRef";
  src.medicationCodeableConcept as mc -> tgt.medicationCodeableConcept = mc "medicationCC";
  src.effectivePeriod as ep -> tgt.effectivePeriod = ep;
  src.recordingMetadata as rm then {
    rm.recordedTime as rt -> tgt.dateAsserted = rt "dateAsserted";
    rm.recorder as rc -> tgt.informationSource = rc "informationSource";
  };
  // R4: reasonCode (CodeableConcept) and reasonReference (Reference) are separate fields.
  // indication / intendedUse are CodeableConcepts -> reasonCode; indicationText -> reasonCode.text
  src.indication as ind -> tgt.reasonCode = ind "reasonIndication";
  src.indicationText as it ->  create('CodeableConcept') as cc,  cc.text = it,  tgt.reasonCode = cc "reasonIndicationText";
  src.intendedUse as iu -> tgt.reasonCode = iu "reasonIntendedUse";
  src.usageInstructions as ui -> tgt.dosage = ui "dosage";
  src.preparationInstructions as pi ->  create('Dosage') as dos,  dos.text = pi,  tgt.dosage = dos "prepInstructions";
  src.comment as cm -> create('Annotation') as nt then {
    cm.commentText as ct -> nt.text = ct "lineNoteText";
    cm.date as d -> nt.time = d "lineNoteTime";
    cm.author as a ->  create('Reference') as ar,  ar.display = (a.name.text),  nt.authorReference = ar "lineNoteAuthor";
    cm -> tgt.note = nt "lineNoteAssign";
  } "lineNote";
  // adherence: R4 MedicationStatement has no native adherence field. The IHE
  // profile carries it via an extension (ihe-ext-medicationstatement-adherence
  // backporting R5 MS.adherence). Populating that extension from treatmentStatus
  // is left to a follow-up; the field would otherwise be silently dropped here.
  src.category as cat -> tgt.category = cat;
  src.derivedFrom as df then {
    df.request as rq -> tgt.derivedFrom = rq "derivedFromRequest";
    df.statement as stm -> tgt.derivedFrom = stm "derivedFromStatement";
    df.dispensation as dsp -> tgt.derivedFrom = dsp "derivedFromDispensation";
    df.administration as adm -> tgt.derivedFrom = adm "derivedFromAdministration";
    df.other as oth -> tgt.derivedFrom = oth "derivedFromOther";
  };
  // Extension: artifact-version (R4 standard extension URL is unchanged)
  src.version as v ->  create('Extension') as ext,  ext.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/artifact-version',  ext.value = v,  tgt.extension = ext "extVersion";
  // Extension: VerificationInformation (IHE Pharm MEOW canonical)
  src.verificationInformation as vi -> create('Extension') as ext then {
    vi -> ext.url = 'http://profiles.ihe.net/PHARM/MEOW/StructureDefinition/ihe-ext-medicationstatement-verificationinformation' "viUrl";
    vi.verifier as vr ->  create('Extension') as e1,  e1.url = 'verifier',  e1.value = vr,  ext.extension = e1 "viVerifier";
    vi.verificationTime as vt ->  create('Extension') as e2,  e2.url = 'verificationTime',  e2.value = vt,  ext.extension = e2 "viTime";
    vi -> tgt.extension = ext "viAssign";
  } "extVerification";
  // Extension: Substitution (IHE Pharm MEOW canonical)
  src.substitution as sub -> create('Extension') as ext then {
    sub -> ext.url = 'http://profiles.ihe.net/PHARM/MEOW/StructureDefinition/ihe-ext-medicationstatement-substitution' "subUrl";
    sub.substitutionType as t ->  create('Extension') as e1,  e1.url = 'substitutionType',  e1.value = t,  ext.extension = e1 "subType";
    sub.substitutionTypeReason as r ->  create('Extension') as e2,  e2.url = 'substitutionTypeReason',  e2.value = r,  ext.extension = e2 "subReason";
    sub.substitutionTypeReasonText as rt ->  create('Extension') as e3,  e3.url = 'substitutionTypeReasonText',  e3.value = rt,  ext.extension = e3 "subReasonText";
    sub -> tgt.extension = ext "subAssign";
  } "extSubstitution";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PractitionerLM -> FHIR Practitioner
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group PractitionerLMToPractitioner(source src : PractitionerLM, target tgt : Practitioner) {
  src.identifier as id -> tgt.identifier = id "practIdentifier";
  src.name as n -> tgt.name = n "practName";
}
